precepts.text: His hand hath formed the crooked serpent. God formed Satan.
precepts.point: The serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field, which the Lord God had made. The serpent is Satan, called a serpent because he is slick and forked-tongued, and God made him exactly as subtil as he is.
precepts.why:
When did the war start? Through the envy of the devil, when he made his move on Adam’s kingdom. And he made that move through Adam’s wife: “Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made.”

The serpent is Satan, the devil. It says serpent, but it is not talking about a snake; he is called a serpent because he is slick, forked-tongued, tricky. And notice, “which the Lord God had made.” God created him to be exactly who he is. He was subtil because God made him subtil.

Job confirms it: “By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.” God formed that crooked serpent, Satan. He is not a rival power that rose up on his own to equal God; he is a creature God made, crooked by design.

So Satan tricked Eve, the weaker vessel, and caused her to sin, and Eve went and convinced her husband to sin. Then the Most High came to deal with Adam, Eve and Satan, and brought judgment on all three. From there God declared the war: “I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”.

That is why we have to know our adversary. The serpent that deceived Eve is the same one we fight today, in his whispers and in his children, and the one who formed him is the one who will judge him.

precepts.text: He hangeth the earth upon nothing.
precepts.point: Time on earth began with the sun and moon on the fourth day, but with God a day is as a thousand years.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

precepts.why:
With a picture of the earth in space on the screen, 2 Esdras 16 was read: “He searcheth the deep, and the treasures thereof; he hath measured the sea, and what it containeth. He hath shut the sea in the midst of the waters, and with his word hath he hanged the earth upon the waters.” All around the earth is space, and the earth hangs in it like an ornament the Lord just hung there. The water it hangs on is space. Astronauts train in the water because that is where they are going; spend too long in space and your bones get brittle, just as they get crushed if you go too deep under water.

Job calls that water something else: “He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.” When you see the earth in space, it is on nothing. You cannot see any water, but the water is there surrounding it. The nothing is the water.

So why doesn't the earth move and float off one way or another? That is the Most High showing his power. 2 Esdras 16:59: “He spreadeth out the heavens like a vault; upon the waters hath he founded it.” A vault is an arch; it goes around, it is round, not flat. Founded means established: the earth stays in the spot where he founded it, while the sun moves. The devil says the opposite, that the earth moves; but God said the earth is founded, and it stays there. This is the same work as Genesis 1:6, where the firmament was set in the midst of the waters.

precepts.text: He that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, a full circle and not a plate or a flat surface, stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain and a tent to dwell in.
precepts.point: The earth is a circle; everything else in the heavens is a full circle, the sun which is a star, the moon, the planets, so it makes no sense to say everything is circular except the earth. This is something Esau made up and distributed throughout the minds of Israelite brothers and sisters worldwide, and it has to be cut.

note.label: Job 26: He Hangeth the Earth Upon Nothing

precepts.why:
Job says he “hangeth the earth upon nothing.” Isaiah says, “It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in”.

The earth is a circle, a full circle, not a plate or a flat surface. Everything else in the heavens is a full circle: the sun, which is a star, the moon, the planets. It makes no sense to say everything is circular except the earth. The flat earth idea is something Esau made up and distributed throughout the minds of Israelite brothers and sisters worldwide, and it has to be cut.

And the earth hangs upon nothing. The Bible does not substantiate Greek mythology where Atlas or a man under the earth holds it up on his back. The Most High sits upon the circle of the earth, stretches out the heavens as a curtain and spreads them out as a tent to dwell in, and its inhabitants are as grasshoppers before him.
